shortDescription: Activate a new current-running config in realtime

options.name: commit_changes
options.description: Used to determine the action to take after transferring the config to the switch.  Either activate using the rollback feature or load on next-reboot.

options.name: config_file
options.description: File that will be sent to the device.  Relative path is location of Ansible playbook.  Recommended to use absolute path.

options.name: diff_file
options.description: File that will be used to store the diffs.  Relative path is location of ansible playbook. If not set, no diffs are saved.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the Comware 7 device that has NETCONF enabled

options.name: look_for_keys
options.description: Whether searching for discoverable private key files in ~/.ssh/

options.name: password
options.description: Password used to login to the switch

options.name: username
options.description: Username used to login to the switch
